pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: SEV2 triggered - inference-gateway 5xx rate spike
pagerduty-bot: Alert: inference-gateway.euw1 > 5xx_rate = 18% (5m) (threshold 5%). Links: <https://pagerduty.example/INC12345|INC12345> • <https://grafana.redwood/obs/inference/5xx?orgId=1|grafana>
incident-bot: Runbook: inference-gateway -> follow '5xx spike' steps. Auto-attach logs / recent deploys.
jana (oncall): Oncall here, I'm taking this. acked via PD. ping @kevin for infra checks.
kevin: looking. initial signal shows a spike from eu-west1 edge pod pool -> lots of keepalive resets to model-runner-shim, upstream 504/502s.
maria: customer impact: retries/ client errors up on /v1/generate for a subset of enterprise customers, sample errors show 502/504. Ticket created for impacted customers.
kevin: quick log snippet:```
[2024-03-12T02:15:11Z] inference-runner: request_id=abc123 upstream_err=504 timeout_ms=12000 model=nlp-full-v1
[2024-03-12T02:15:12Z] inference-runner: request_id=def456 upstream_err=502 connection_reset
```
ops-runbook-bot: Suggested mitigations: 1) drain problem edge nodes 2) shift partial traffic to fallback model variant 3) increase model-pool replicas in euw1.
jana (oncall): start traffic shift to compact model variant (compact-v2) at 20% in euw1, and scale model-pool +1 replica. I'll coordinate with kevin.
kevin: running commands now:```
infractl traffic set-weight --service inference-service --region eu-west1 --from=n1-full-v1 --to=compact-v2 --weight 20
infractl scale set --service model-pool-euw1 --replicas +1
```
kevin: commands executed, confirming routing change propagated.
maria: monitoring customer errors, opening a customer DM thread for the top 3 impacted accounts. attaching retry guidance.
sre-olivia: seeing 5xx drop in tail: now 9% last 2m, 4.5% last 5m. nice. keep an eye on latency.
jana (oncall): good progress. I'll remain primary until handoff in 30m. kevin, can you follow up on why keepalive resets spiked? assign to infra post-mortem.
kevin: filing infra ticket INF-789 to investigate connection churn and TCP keepalive settings, linking to this PD.
incident-bot: PD note: incident acknowledged by jana at 1702103338. escalation paused.
maria: customer note sent for two enterprise tenants, asking them to retry and we are monitoring.
kevin: further check: model-runner-shim logs show GC pauses on a subset of pods (heap pressure) around the spike window. adding memory headroom to those hosts now.
jana (oncall): update: 5xx now ~3% over last 5m. keeping alert open for 1 hour to verify stability. handing to kevin for follow-up; I'll check back at +30. :thumbsup:
kevin: ack, I'll continue monitoring and start the infra investigation.
ops-runbook-bot: Reminders: capture heap dumps from affected runner pods, collect pprof, and preserve logs for 1 week.
incident-bot: Closing note: monitoring continuing. If 5xx > 6% again, PD will re-trigger.
